commit.message:
feat(storm-kubernetes): Refactor configuration to use environment variables

- Add centralized environment variable ConfigMap for all Storm configuration
- Make storm.yaml ConfigMap optional via cluster.stormYaml setting
- Update all deployments to use envFrom with environment ConfigMap
- Remove log4j2 XML configurations (now handled by Storm container)
- Update image tags to use new Storm container version 2.8.1-17-jre
- Add migration guide for updating from previous versions
- Mark cluster.logFormat and clusterConfig section as deprecated
- Remove unused helper functions from templates
- Add comprehensive test script for configuration validation
- Update documentation with examples for both configuration approaches

BREAKING CHANGE: Configuration now uses environment variables in ConfigMap.
Users should migrate from cluster.logFormat to component-level LOG_FORMAT
environment variable. See MIGRATION.md for details.

feat(storm-kubernetes): Add memory management, Datadog integration, and supervisor improvements

Major enhancements to the Storm Kubernetes Helm chart:

Memory Configuration:
- Add flexible memory configuration system with auto/manual modes
- Implement memory validation helpers in _helpers.tpl
- Support automatic resource calculation based on worker requirements
- Add memory configuration examples and documentation

Monitoring & Observability:
- Add comprehensive Datadog integration with unified service tagging
- Support JSON logging format for structured logs
- Add automatic log collection annotations
- Inject DD_ENV, DD_SERVICE, DD_VERSION environment variables

Supervisor Improvements:
- Fix supervisor connection issues by using pod IP for storm.local.hostname
- Support flexible worker-per-supervisor configurations
- Add dynamic scaling capabilities
- Fix "getLeader failed after 3 attempts" errors

Configuration Updates:
- Update default values for development environments
- Add production-ready value files with HPA and PDB
- Enhanced security configurations
- Improve storm-local-values.yaml for local development

Documentation:
- Add comprehensive CHANGELOG.md
- Update README with new configuration options
- Add memory management guide
- Include examples for all new features

BREAKING CHANGES:
- Replace autoMemory with memoryConfig system
- Change default supervisor count from 3 to 1

Version bump to 0.1.8

feat(storm-kubernetes): Add enhanced metrics collector with Datadog and OTEL support

- Add comprehensive Storm metrics collector as ConfigMap
- Implement proper Prometheus exposition format with grouped metrics
- Add OpenTelemetry environment variables support
- Add Datadog integration with labels and DD_* env vars
- Move service metadata (name, version, environment) to top level
- Update metrics exporter deployment to use enhanced collector
- Add node selector and tolerations for metrics exporter
- Enable console logging with log4j2 configuration
- Configure JMX metrics reporter in cluster config

feat(storm-kubernetes): Add authentication support (Kerberos/SASL)

- Add Kerberos authentication with krb5.conf and JAAS configuration
- Support keytab file management via secrets
- Add SASL configuration for Kafka integration
- Mount auth configs in nimbus and supervisor pods
- Include production authentication values example
- Update schema with authentication parameters
- Support both simple and Kerberos transport plugins

feat(storm-kubernetes): Add HorizontalPodAutoscaler support for supervisors

- Add HPA template with CPU and memory based scaling
- Support custom metrics for advanced scaling scenarios
- Add configurable scaling behavior with stabilization
- Include production HPA values example
- Update schema with HPA configuration options
- Enable dynamic scaling from 3 to 20 supervisors by default

feat(storm-kubernetes): Add Ingress with TLS support for Storm UI

- Add ingress template with nginx and ALB controller support
- Add self-signed certificate generation for development
- Add production ingress values with security headers
- Add WebSocket support for real-time UI updates
- Add CORS and rate limiting configuration
- Add cert-manager annotations for production TLS

feat: Add PodDisruptionBudgets for high availability

- Add PDB templates for Nimbus, Supervisor, and UI components
- Configure sensible defaults (maxUnavailable for Nimbus, minAvailable for others)
- Add unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy for better handling of failing pods
- Include production PDB values example with HA configurations
- Support both minAvailable and maxUnavailable strategies
- Ensure cluster stability during voluntary disruptions

feat: Add comprehensive monitoring stack for Storm Kubernetes

- Add metrics exporter deployment that polls Storm UI API
- Create ServiceMonitor for Prometheus Operator integration
- Add PrometheusRule with alerts for Storm components and resources
- Include Grafana dashboard for Storm cluster overview
- Add production monitoring values example
- Expose metrics for supervisors, topologies, slots, memory, and CPU
- Support for Prometheus scraping and alerting
- Metrics exporter uses Python HTTP server for reliable metrics serving

fix: Add security context to init containers and document Storm user UID

- Apply security context to wait-for-nimbus init containers
- Document that Storm user/group in official image uses UID/GID 1000
- Ensure consistent security across all containers including init containers

feat: Add comprehensive security features to Storm Kubernetes chart

- Add ServiceAccount creation and RBAC with appropriate permissions
- Add Pod and Container SecurityContexts with non-root user (UID 1000)
- Add NetworkPolicy support for traffic isolation between components
- Add PodSecurityPolicy support for older clusters
- Configure security contexts for all Storm components (Nimbus, Supervisor, UI)
- Add production security example values file
- Disable automountServiceAccountToken in production config
- Set proper capabilities dropping and privilege escalation prevention
- Add seccomp profiles and other security hardening measures

feat: Add hybrid auto/manual memory management for Storm supervisors

- Add memoryConfig section to supervisor values with auto/manual modes
- Create memory helper templates that calculate container resources based on worker requirements
- Auto mode calculates container memory/CPU from slots and per-worker settings
- Worker heap is automatically set to 80% of per-worker memory
- Add memory validation to prevent misconfiguration
- Update NOTES.txt to display memory configuration and cluster capacity
- Fix floating point calculations using mulf instead of mul

feat: Refactor Storm Kubernetes chart with Bitnami common patterns

- Add Bitnami common library dependency for consistent patterns
- Implement global settings support (imageRegistry, imagePullSecrets, storageClass)
- Create comprehensive style guide documenting Bitnami patterns
- Implement extraConfig pattern for modular configuration
- Move components from disabled templates back to main chart
- Add memory management design documentation with recommended hybrid approach
- Fix log4j2 console logging configuration
- Add comprehensive tests for global settings validation
- Update values.yaml structure to follow Bitnami conventions

feat: Complete Helm chart refactoring and test improvements

Major changes:
- Separated storm-operator and storm-crd-cluster charts for better modularity
- Created storm-shared library chart for common templates
- Added comprehensive documentation for all charts including READMEs and architecture docs
- Fixed and updated controller tests to work with new architecture

Chart structure:
- storm-operator: Deploys the Storm Operator and optional Zookeeper
- storm-crd-cluster: Creates StormCluster CRs for operator management
- storm-shared: Common templates and helpers
- storm-kubernetes: Legacy all-in-one deployment (preserved for compatibility)

Documentation:
- Added comprehensive READMEs for storm-operator and storm-crd-cluster
- Created HELM_CHART_ARCHITECTURE.md detailing the new chart structure
- Updated controller-architecture.md with new deployment patterns
- Added KNOWN_ISSUES.md documenting test status and config limitations

Test improvements:
- Fixed operator config loading tests
- Added comprehensive config type handling tests
- Updated test expectations to match new defaults
- Documented fake client limitations for lifecycle tests

Configuration:
- Added example values files (minimal, production, local) for all charts
- Implemented proper config merging with type preservation
- Added tests for boolean, integer, and string type handling

refactor: Simplify default Storm cluster configuration and fix CRD management

- Set default supervisor count to 1 with 1 worker slot per supervisor
- Remove duplicate CRD files and use generated CRDs from src/config/crd/bases
- Add sync-crds.sh script to copy generated CRDs to Helm chart
- Update Makefile to automatically sync CRDs when running 'make manifests'
- Add stormcluster-crd-only.yaml example for future CRD-only deployment mode
- Document CRD-only mode as a future enhancement in README

These changes provide a minimal default Storm cluster configuration suitable
for development and testing, while ensuring CRDs stay in sync between the
controller source and Helm chart.

test: Add comprehensive tests for state machine controllers

- Add unit and integration tests for StormTopology controller state machine
- Add unit and integration tests for StormWorkerPool controller state machine
- Test state transitions, reconciliation flows, and resource management
- Include mock implementations for Storm client and client manager
- Achieve full test coverage for state machine logic

fix: Improve supervisor health checks in Helm chart

- Replace HTTP health checks with command-based probes for supervisors
- Liveness probe: Check supervisor process with pgrep (lightweight, local)
- Readiness probe: Verify Nimbus connectivity with storm list (network check)
- Adjust probe timings for better reliability:
  - Liveness: 60s initial, 30s interval (process stability)
  - Readiness: 45s initial, 15s interval (network responsiveness)

This ensures supervisors won't restart due to temporary Nimbus unavailability
and won't accept work until they can communicate with Nimbus.

feat: Add StormCluster Helm integration with reference mode and fix status display

- Add StormCluster resource deployment via Helm chart with configurable management mode
- Implement reference mode to adopt existing Helm-deployed resources (StatefulSets, Deployments, Services)
- Add ResourceNamesSpec for mapping external resource names in reference mode
- Fix supervisor count display showing 1 instead of actual count (3)
- Add SlotsInfo field for formatted slot display (used/total format)
- Update CRD printcolumn to use .status.slotsInfo for SLOTS column
- Add periodic status updates to ensure component counts stay current
- Fix ConfigMap generation to use correct service names in reference mode
- Disable supervisor health probes in test values to prevent crashes
- Add comprehensive coordination layer for cross-resource health monitoring

Key improvements:
- Helm chart now optionally creates StormCluster resource with stormCluster.enabled flag
- Controller properly adopts existing resources without creating duplicates
- Supervisor counts and slot calculations now update correctly
- State machine properly transitions from Creating to Running state

feat: Add Storm Kubernetes Helm chart

- Add comprehensive Helm chart for deploying Storm clusters
- Include CRD definitions with conditional installation
- Support for Nimbus StatefulSet with HA configuration
- Supervisor deployment with configurable worker slots
- Optional Storm UI with Ingress support and authentication
- Integrated controller deployment (disabled by default)
- Zookeeper dependency with embedded or external options
- Multiple values files for different deployment scenarios
- Support for monitoring with Prometheus integration
- Comprehensive RBAC and security configurations
